Torque converter and flex-plate bellhousing visible, consistent with a front-wheel-drive automatic transaxle.

risks.risk: Internal condition (clutch packs, solenoids, torque converter lock-up) unknown; could be seized, worn, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the input/output shaft turning freely and a bench or stall test, or a shop diagnostic report.

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific Ford Fusion engine/trim cannot be confirmed without a readable part or casting number.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped part number or VIN-matched tag on the case (the tag visible in photo 0/1).
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified-fitment generic used transaxle, not Fusion-specific premium

risks.risk: Possible internal/external leaks or seal damage not visible due to dirt and oil residue on the case.
risks.proof: Clean close-up photos of the seals, gasket mating surfaces, and output shaft seal area.

risks.risk: Risk of mix-up: unit stored among many similar transmissions in a shared yard; the exact piece sold may differ from photographed one.
risks.proof: A photo of the unit with a dated hand-written tag or seller holding today's newspaper/date next to it.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added uncertainty discount for substitution risk

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the part/casting number or VIN tag on the transmission case.
Video of the input shaft being turned by hand to show it rotates smoothly without grinding.
Photo of the transmission fluid (color/smell description) via dipstick or pan if accessible.
Confirmation of exact Ford Fusion model year and engine size it was pulled from, with a receipt or import invoice if available.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission/transaxle, but the Ford Fusion fitment and working condition are unverified from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst case: generic unverified-fitment, untested used transaxle, not a confirmed Ford Fusion unit in known-good condition.
